<!-- Generated by Ankus.DocGenerator. -->

Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Declares a function created by a custom SQL block for named selection and extension attachment.

```csharp
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Assembly, AllowMultiple = true)]
public sealed class PgSqlFunctionProviderAttribute : Attribute
```

The signature is authored SQL, such as app.calculate(integer, text), and must identify an existing function after the block runs.
Use explicit schema qualification when the block installs into a fixed schema. PostgreSQL validates the signature when executing the selected script.

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object), [Attribute](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.attribute)

Parameters:

`sqlId` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

The identifier of a PgSql or PgSqlFile block.

`signature` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

The SQL function name and argument type list, without a FUNCTION keyword.

The signature is authored SQL, such as app.calculate(integer, text), and must identify an existing function after the block runs.
Use explicit schema qualification when the block installs into a fixed schema. PostgreSQL validates the signature when executing the selected script.
